text.en: Rani is a curious girl who asks many questions. One morning her brother shouts, “Look, India is on the Moon!”

Rani lives in a village. She is very curious and asks her family, teachers and friends many questions, like why the sky is blue.
One evening she hears her mother singing the Chanda Mama song and asks how far the Moon is. Her mother says it is very far.
The next morning her brother Pratik is excited, pointing at the TV: India is on the Moon!
Rani sees photos of machines on the Moon and hears people speak about the landing.
She asks Pratik how Chandrayaan reached the Moon, and he tells her what his friend Vivaan explained.
Chandrayaan is the name of India's Moon missions (additional, not in the textbook).
Asking questions is the best way to learn.
New words: curious, landing, machine.
